title: Account
subtitle: Export your data, or permanently delete your account.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.description: Switch between a light and dark look.

digest.heading: Weekly email digest
digest.description: A weekly email with applications that have gone quiet, upcoming interviews, and your study streak.

export.heading: Export your data
export.description: Downloads a JSON file with your profile, vacancies, companies, and study progress — everything you've created in DevRadar.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete your account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your account and everything in it — vacancies, companies, CV, study progress. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmationSent: Check your email — click the link we sent to confirm the deletion. Nothing has been deleted yet.
